meta.name: github-triage
meta.description: Read-only GitHub triage for issues AND PRs. 1 item = 1 background task (category: quick). Analyzes all open items and writes evidence-backed reports to /tmp/{datetime}/. Every claim requires a GitHub permalink as proof. NEVER takes any action on GitHub - no comments, no merges, no closes, no labels. Reports only. Triggers: 'triage', 'triage issues', 'triage PRs', 'github triage'.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 自动分析 GitHub 仓库的所有议题和 PR，生成带证据的审阅报告
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果你需要快速了解仓库中所有待办事项的现状和优先级
copy.tagline_en: Analyze all open issues and PRs on GitHub, generating evidence-backed triage reports
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need a quick overview of all open items in a GitHub repository with evidence

howto.what: 装上后，Claude 会读取当前仓库所有未关闭的 issue 和 PR，为每项启动后台分析，并把报告写到 /tmp/{时间戳}/。报告里的每个论断要么附 GitHub 代码链接作证据，要么标成 [UNVERIFIED]；它只读，不会在 GitHub 上评论、合并、关闭或打标签。
howto.when: 当你说出“triage”“triage issues”“triage PRs”等关键词，要求分析仓库的 issue 或 PR 时触发。

say.text: 对这个仓库做 github triage。
say.note: 把打开的 issue/PR 逐项分析成报告，存到 /tmp。
触发后台分析，按条目生成报告。
针对打开的 PR 做分析并写出报告。

howto.what_en: Reads all open issues/PRs, one background subtask each, writes evidence-backed reports to /tmp/{datetime}/. Every claim must cite a commit permalink or else be marked [UNVERIFIED]. Never comments, merges, closes, or labels—reports only.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you say keywords such as "triage", "triage issues", "triage PRs" asking to analyze a repo's issues or PRs.

say_en.text: Do a github triage on this repo.
say_en.note: Analyzes each open issue/PR and stores its report in /tmp.
Runs the analysis and generates per-item reports.
Analyzes open PRs and writes reports.
